articles.summary: Explore by Del Webb Jordanelle Ridge brings the brand’s signature style of wellness and elevated amenities to one of Utah’s most sought-after destinations Mountains, luxury design and wellness with a view. PulteGroup (NYSE: PHM), the nation’s third-largest home builder, is bringing Explore by Del Webb to Utah’s Jordanelle Ridge, marking the latest expansion of its newest brand. Launched in 2025, Explore draws on Del Webb’s 65 years of experience creating resort-style communities. Offering a fresh perspective, Explore communities are centered on thoughtful designs, elevated amenities and experiences that make it easy to live well, stay active and connect. Just minutes from Park City and Deer Valley, Explore by Del Webb Jordanelle Ridge is planned for approximately 900 homes and will offer a distinctly Utah expression of the Explore lifestyle and year-round recreation. articles.title: Explore by Del Webb Expands into Utah with New Community Near Park City
